newsitem.title: USA: Humana says profits fall in third quarter.
newsitem.headline: Humana says profits fall in third quarter.

text.p: Humana Inc. reported a drop in its third quarter earnings Wednesday and cited an increase in medical and administrative costs and severance payments under a management reorganization plan.
The provider of managed health care services said earnings fell to $32 million, or 20 cents a share, for the third quarter from $43 million, or 27 cents a share, a year ago.
The current year's results included $5 million to $6 million, or 2 cents a share, for severance payments, the company said.

Humana said its acquisition of Emphesys Financial Group, Inc. in October 1995, buoyed revenues for the third quarter to $1.8 billion from $1.1 billion for the same quarter a year ago, the company said.

Humana, based in Louisville, Ky., began delivering managed health care services to military beneficiaries under a contract, which contributed premium revenue of $170 million during the third quarter, the company said.
For the nine months ended September 30, 1996, Humana reported net income of $120 million, or 74 cents per share, compared to $141 million, or 87 cents per share, for the same period last year.
